description: California SB 253 and SB 261 climate disclosure compliance workflow and readiness toolkit.
image_alt: Institute of Sustainability logo and compliance toolkit

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team of regulatory analysts tracks CARB guidance and California legislative updates to maintain the SB 253 and SB 261 readiness toolkits.

editorial.testing: All compliance workflows are tested against current CARB guidance and the text of SB 253 and SB 261.
editorial.monetization: We generate revenue through site sponsorships and sales of our paid readiness toolkit for sustainability and finance leads.
editorial.corrections: We date every page. If CARB issues new guidance or legislation shifts, we update our materials and log the correction with the date of the change.
